datastores.name: Identity store
datastores.description: The relational store of the identity service: member credentials and the tokens of a password reset.

tables.name: reset_token
tables.description: One row for each password reset a member asked for: the hash of the token, when it expires and when it was used.

tables.name: member_credential
tables.description: One row for each member: the hash of the current password and when it was last changed.
tables.scope_reason: The credential table exists already and this release does not change it; it is described here so that a later release can.

validation_rules.name: a reset token expires
validation_rules.check: Every row of reset_token has an expires_at later than the moment the row was written.

validation_rules.name: a reset token is used once
validation_rules.check: A row of reset_token whose used_at is set is never accepted for a second reset.
